# Shelf of Fame visual instructions

Before making visual, layout, CSS, theme, scene-asset, component-styling, or responsive changes, read `/DESIGN.md` and treat it as the visual source of truth.

Core direction: **A real, moody library that happens to be interactive — not a bookshelf app decorated to look like a library.**

- Treat Botanical as the flagship benchmark for scene quality while preserving the existing multi-theme system.
- Keep books and shelf interaction visually dominant.
- Preserve approved/generated scene assets and spine artwork; do not replace them with crude CSS approximations for convenience.
- Scope Botanical changes narrowly, normally beneath `html[data-shelf-theme="botanical"]`.
- Do not use the legacy light/beige global styling as the Botanical design reference.
- Preserve left-side daylight logic, dimensional walnut shelving, cream literary typography, restrained sage controls, and aged brass accents.
- Simplify decor on mobile before sacrificing book usability, navigation, or touch targets.
- Avoid white SaaS cards, glassmorphism, giant marketing heroes, random book leans, global orange filters, and unrelated restyling during focused feature work.
- Preserve graceful fallbacks and existing theme/data behavior unless the task explicitly changes them.
- For major visual work, check the acceptance checklist in `/DESIGN.md` before considering the task complete.
